{"metadata":{"description":"💬 Chat with your DeepSeek Harness agent from WeChat through the official WeChat ClawBot channel: native photo understanding, sending files both ways, reminders, long-term memory, and a "typing..." indicator while the bot is thinking.","id":"gh:1344535308","install_available":true,"language":"TypeScript","name":"wechat-clawbot","slug":"Alphainfix/wechat-clawbot","topics":["agent","bot","deepseek-harness","deepseek-harness-plugin","dsh-plugin","wechat"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"💬 Chat with your DeepSeek Harness agent from WeChat through the official WeChat ClawBot channel: nat"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"ive photo understanding, sending files both ways, reminders, long-term memory, and a "typing..." ind"},{"id":"p1s3","text":"icator while the bot is thinking."},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# wechat-clawbot"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"Chat with the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent on your computer from WeChat.
Clawbot is a DSH plugin and"},{"id":"p4s2","text":" fully open source. It replies with the AI you use in DSH and does not upload your information.
Away"},{"id":"p4s3","text":" from your desk, you can still ask it to look through files, edit documents or run commands, and the"},{"id":"p4s4","text":" results come back to the WeChat chat.
It can also plan your days from the system calendar, create e"},{"id":"p4s5","text":"vents for you, and set alarms that ring on your phone (macOS only)."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"It uses WeChat's official **微信ClawBot** channel: just scan a QR code to log in."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"After nearly two months of development and real-world use, `wechat-clawbot` has become steadily more"},{"id":"p6s2","text":" stable and economical, and the stable release **v1.0.0** came out on 10 October 2026."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## What it does"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- **Put your computer to work from WeChat**: "what's the newest PDF in Downloads?", "run this script"},{"id":"p8s2","text":""
- **Understands photos**: send a picture and ask what it is. If the model accepts images, the phot"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"o goes to it directly
- **Sends files back**: "send me README.md", "make a chart and send it". Image"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"s, PDFs, Office files and archives all work
- **"Typing…"**: while it thinks, works or sends you a f"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ile, WeChat shows the bot as typing, just like a person, until the reply arrives
- **Reminders**: "r"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"emind me at 9 tomorrow to hand in the report", and you get a WeChat message on time
- **Long-term me"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"mory**: remembers your habits and preferences, so you don't have to repeat them
- **Asks before it a"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"cts**: anything that needs your approval (e.g. touching files outside its working directory) is aske"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"d in WeChat; reply `同意` / `拒绝` (or `yes` / `no`)
- **Understands quotes**: reply to an older message"},{"id":"p8s10","text":" with WeChat's quote feature and it knows which one you mean
- **Long chats stay quick**: when the c"},{"id":"p8s11","text":"onversation gets long, it tidies older messages into a summary during a quiet spell after a reply, s"},{"id":"p8s12","text":"o your next message never waits for it
- **All-day secretary (macOS only, off until you turn it on)*"},{"id":"p8s13","text":"*: plans your days and creates events from the Mac's calendar, and sets alarms that really ring. It "},{"id":"p8s14","text":"plans by default rules you can rewrite, and you set up any daily routine in chat."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## All-day secretary: plan your days and set alarms from WeChat (new; macOS only, off until you turn"},{"id":"p9s2","text":"day secretary: plan your days and set alarms from WeChat (new; macOS only, off until you turn it on)"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"- **Sees your whole schedule**: reads every account in the Mac Calendar app (iCloud, Google, Exchang"},{"id":"p10s2","text":"e, subscribed calendars), notes included. Ask "am I free tomorrow afternoon?" and it checks the cale"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"ndar before answering.
- **Plans straight into your calendar**: tell it "the report is due Thursday "},{"id":"p10s4","text":"and I still have two papers to read". It finds free time, puts the work into **a dedicated calendar "},{"id":"p10s5","text":"you name yourself**, and replies in a few lines: what happens when, what got moved, where things cla"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"sh. The calendar is created in iCloud when you have it, so the events show up on your phone too, and"},{"id":"p10s7","text":" it still reminds you on WeChat when it's time.
- **Free hand only in its own calendar**: it adds, c"},{"id":"p10s8","text":"hanges and deletes events in the dedicated calendar by itself. For anything in your other calendars "},{"id":"p10s9","text":"it asks you on WeChat first and waits for a yes, unless you switch off **改别的日历前先问我** in the settings"},{"id":"p10s10","text":" (it still asks first about a change that would notify other attendees).
- **Reminders stay reminder"},{"id":"p10s11","text":"s**: a plain "remind me to…" becomes a WeChat reminder and stays out of the calendar. Only things th"},{"id":"p10s12","text":"at take up time go into the calendar.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p11s1","text":"## Cost"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"- When the author uses gpt-6-luna, one WeChat message costs about $0.005–0.007 on average; at around"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" 7 messages a day that is about $1.4 a month (under ¥10)."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## Requirements"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"- DSH **0.1.7 – 0.2.2** (tested on 0.1.7-rc.2, 0.2.0-rc.2, 0.2.1-rc.2 and 0.2.2-rc.1), Node.js 22+ a"},{"id":"p14s2","text":"nd pnpm
- The official **微信ClawBot** plugin in the WeChat mobile app (WeChat → Settings → Plugins; t"},{"id":"p14s3","text":"he first scan may ask you to update WeChat)
- A computer that stays on: the bot is online while DSH "},{"id":"p14s4","text":"is running
- For the all-day secretary (macOS only):
- **Calendar planning**: macOS 14 or later and "},{"id":"p14s5","text":"the Xcode command line tools (`xcode-select --install` if you don't have them)
- **Alarms**: the Mac"},{"id":"p14s6","text":" needs **macOS 26.2 or later**. Any Mac with Apple silicon will do; only four Intel Macs can run mac"},{"id":"p14s7","text":"OS 26 (see Apple's list).
- **Phone** (for alarms): an **iPhone 11 or later, or iPhone SE (2nd or 3r"},{"id":"p14s8","text":"d generation)**, on **iOS 26.2 or later**. Reminders has to use iCloud on both the Mac and the iPhon"},{"id":"p14s9","text":"e, with the same Apple Account. The alarm rings only on the iPhone that Find My uses as your locatio"},{"id":"p14s10","text":"n; a Mac only shows a notification."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"## Privacy and safety"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"- **Only you**: messages from anyone but the person who scanned the QR code are ignored.
- **Approva"},{"id":"p16s2","text":"ls come to you**: anything DSH needs you to approve is asked in WeChat, and nothing happens until yo"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"u answer.
- **Where your messages go**: to the model configured for this session in DSH. If you ask "},{"id":"p16s4","text":"the bot to relay a message to Claude Code or Codex, it also sends that message to the selected local"},{"id":"p16s5","text":" coding session.
- **Auto-memory** (on by default): short messages that look like lasting facts ("I "},{"id":"p16s6","text":"don't drink coffee") get a second
question to **the same model**: should this be remembered? To turn"},{"id":"p16s7","text":" it off, add `autoMemory: false` to the `clawbot`
entry in `cordis.patch.yml`. It takes effect on th"},{"id":"p16s8","text":"e next message.
- **All-day secretary** (off by default): when the bot looks at your calendar, the e"},{"id":"p16s9","text":"vents it reads (notes included) go to the model, and so do the titles and times of what is in its al"},{"id":"p16s10","text":"arm list. Only you can use the calendar and alarms; while anyone else is on the allow list, these to"},{"id":"p16s11","text":"ols refuse every request.
- The WeChat link and the long-term memory are stored on your computer, un"},{"id":"p16s12","text":"der `~/.dsh/clawbot/`."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"## Limitations"},{"id":"p18s1","text":"- No group chats. Voice messages can be received but not sent.
- One WeChat account per DSH installa"},{"id":"p18s2","text":"tion.
- The bot is offline while the computer is off or DSH is not running.
- The all-day secretary "},{"id":"p18s3","text":"is macOS only, and alarms also need an iPhone (versions under Requirements)."}],"truncated":true}
